## Think bigger. Klistra keeps up.

From depth and transitions to your own media, your numbers, your soundtrack and every format: the range of a whole studio, directed by you.

### Whatever you can picture

From a clean title card to a scene that turns in three dimensions: if you can describe it, Klistra can make it.

- Whatever you can picture From a clean title card to a scene that turns in three dimensions: if you can describe it, Klistra can make it.

- Built around what you bring Your photos and your logo become part of the design and take on its style, instead of sitting on top of it.

- Transitions with intent Scenes can flow into one another the way a motion designer would plan them, not just cut.

- Your numbers, made clear Charts and diagrams drawn from your own figures, animated so the point lands.

- Built-in sync to sound Add music or a voiceover, and cuts, motion and words can follow the beat or the spoken word.

- Every format from one idea The same design, composed again for each screen it goes to. Nothing cropped, nothing squeezed.

## Designed, not generated.

Video generators paint every frame from noise, so each try is a new guess. Klistra builds every scene from parts and sets each detail on purpose. Change anything, and it renders again exactly the same, except what you changed.

### A video generator

Paints every frame from noise. Each try is a new guess.

- Your words, imagined as pixels

- Your media, redrawn from memory

- One change, a whole new video

- Run it again, get something else

- A few details, loosely followed

- Short clips, at the sizes it allows

- Faces and products drift from shot to shot

### Klistra

Builds every scene from parts and sets each detail on purpose.

- Your words, set as real type

- Your media, your exact files

- One change, only that changes

- Render again, the same video

- Exact control over unlimited details

- No limits on length, resolution or fps

- Consistent across the whole project

Want generated media in it too? Have Klistra generate a clip, a picture, a voice or a tune, and it becomes one part of the scene, placed exactly where you say.
